title: Restricted Parallel V1 Worker-Memory Scaling Characterization

worker_pool.finding: backends(worker_count), transaction_controls(worker_count) and worker_runtime(worker_count) are allocated by worker count, not logical-column count

backend.finding: each worker backend materializes one current soil-geometry/MvG parameter cache and one current forcing cache; caches are replaced between columns

column_scaled_payload.committed_physical_state_minimum_array_s: 2*n+2 real64 values per column for pressure head, water content, ponding depth and groundwater level in the no-snow V1 state
column_scaled_payload.logical_column_metadata: separate compact fmr_logical_column_t metadata; no heavy Richards workspace is stored per column
column_scaled_payload.immutable_parameters: registry-owned and logically shared across columns; worker backend currently copies only the active parameter set into its reusable worker-local cache

important_interpretation: known_dynamic_payload is not RSS and is not a total memory bound
allocatable descriptors, pointer descriptors, allocator bookkeeping, scalar derived-type storage and compiler/runtime/OpenMP overhead are excluded
transaction-local checkpoint/candidate/result temporaries can coexist across active workers and are not quantified here
the numeric 2792-byte example is deliberately tiny because the frozen qualification fixture has only four soil nodes
production memory growth with active soil nodes is represented by the formula, not by the four-node byte count

A23BU HeadCalc scratch is still allocated per worker although the canonical explicit HeadCalc route primarily operates on reference_richards_workspace scratch; eliminating redundant scratch requires a separate qualified optimization

architecture_assessment.invariant_4_compact_persistent_state: PASS_WITHIN_SCOPE: no heavy solver workspace is persisted per logical column
architecture_assessment.invariant_5_scratch_per_worker: PASS: identified heavy solver scratch scales by worker count
architecture_assessment.invariant_6_scalable_memory_layout: PASS_WITHIN_SCOPE: heavy workspace count is O(workers), not O(columns)
architecture_assessment.invariant_16_multiswap_primary: PASS_WITHIN_SCOPE: worker ownership avoids one heavy solver instance per column
architecture_assessment.invariant_27_optional_scales_with_use: PASS_WITHIN_V1_SCOPE: excluded optional physics carries no admitted parallel runtime payload beyond generic metadata

optimization_candidates_not_implemented: remove or avoid allocating redundant A23BU HeadCalc scratch on the canonical explicit route after dedicated qualification
reduce per-column parameter/forcing cache reallocation by worker-owned reusable capacity or immutable direct views where ownership permits
characterize transaction-local transient peak memory separately on realistic vertical node counts
